text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Hey, hey! There's something I've been 
wanting to ask the two of you for the 
longest time—

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
What's it like having an older sister?! I 
only have a little brother, so I've always 
wondered!

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
Indeed... Both of them have retired from 
racing now, but they are seniors in 
life... whom I deeply respect.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
"...I think my sister is an Umamusume 
worthy of respect, too... She's so 
radiant, and—"

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
Responsible, strong... kind of like 
someone who leads the way, I guess.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Someone respectable, strong, and 
dependable... Man, that's so nice. Must 
feel like having a reassuring ally by your 
side forever!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
"...Going by that, Kita-san is... really 
like a big sister... maybe."

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
Indeed, she is the type to pull others 
forward.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Huh? I kinda thought having an older 
sister sounded nice, but... Ehehe, when 
you put it like that—

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
You make me want to adopt you as little 
sisters! My dear little sisters~! So 
adorable~!!

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
...You really are suited to being an older 
sister.
